description:
🍓 Strawberry Gelato with Dark Chocolate Stracciatella

This Strawberry Gelato is smooth, fruity, and incredibly easy to make — no complicated reductions, no fancy fruit prep.
-----------
This is the site for the web app, and other caluclators: https://icecreamcalc.com/
-----------

The secret?...... Store-bought strawberry jam.

Using jam gives you:
✔ Consistent flavour
✔ Properly balanced sugar content (ish lol)
✔ No excess water from fresh strawberries

Then we finish it the Italian way — with ribbons of crisp dark chocolate stracciatella shattered directly into the churning gelato for that perfect snap against creamy strawberry.

This is a simple method with professional-level results.

⸻

🧪 What Makes This Work

Strawberries are naturally high in water and low in solids — terrible for texture if handled poorly. Jam solves that problem by concentrating flavour and increasing sugar solids, which lowers freezing point and improves scoopability.

Then tempered dark chocolate with olicve oil hardens instantly in the cold gelato, creating delicate chocolate flakes throughout.

Texture science. Flavour balance. Zero shortcuts in the final result.

Finially finished off "Topped" just like a Ben & Jerry's tub...... only MUCH better 😂

⸻

⏱ Timestamps

0:00 Intro
0:10 Using an Ice Cream Calculator to add a "Special Ingredient"
7:00 Let's make this....
9:30 Churning and the Dark Chocolate Stacciatella
10:25 The results
12:20 Outro

⸻

🍨 Ingredients

Strawberry Jam 299g (1 cup)
Skim milk powder 64.7g (0.5 cups + 1 tbsp)
Milk 3.25 777.9g (3.25 cups)
Sugar 74.9g (0.3 cups + 1 tsp)
Cream (33-36%) 278.4g (1 cup + 2 tbsp)
Stabilizer 4g (0.75 tsp-1 tsp)

Stacciatella:
100g 60-70% Dark Chocolate
15-20g Extra Virgin Olive Oil

⸻

🔥 Pro Tips

• Pay attention to the jam's sugar content, thats SUPER important
• Watch out for suagr substitutes in Jams as they will throw off the balance FAST
• Pour chocolate in a thin stream for fine flakes and add LOTS!
• Let gelato harden off for 4–6 hours before serving

⸻

If you enjoy professional-level ice cream made simple, subscribe to Polar Ice Creamery for science-backed recipes that actually work.

⸻
